==Dialogue==
{{section-stub}}
In [[Grenth's Footprint]]:
:''"My name is Orozar Highstone. I am the Deldrimor Minister of Affairs and a close aid to King Jalis Ironhammer. I tell you this only so that we may do business. I would prefer that you do not tell others that I am here."''
:''"It seems my brother has decided to join the Stone Summit. I need someone to help me get into Sorrow's Furnace and convince him of the error of his ways."''

In Battledepths and during Attack on Jalis's Camp:
:''"Some time ago, King Jalis sent my brother Ural north to gather intelligence on the Stone Summit's movements up here. My brother and I have had our differences to be sure, but after that debacle in Sorrow's Furnace he reformed and dedicated his life to the service of Dwayna. I've come up here with King Jalis in the hopes of seeing Ural and, perhaps, sharking a tankard...or twenty...of ale with him."''

Epilogue:
:''"[[Jalis Ironhammer|Jalis]] told us a hero would come. But he also said our battle was not yet finished. The [[rite of the Great Dwarf]] calls us. We go."''
